db module

School Management System - Database Module

This module handles all interactions with the SQLite database for the School Management System. It provides CRUD operations for students, instructors, and courses, as well as registration, assignment, searching, and backup.

author:

Hilda Awada

project:

School Management System (Lab 2 - PyQt)

db.init_db(db_path: str = 'school.db') → None[source]

Initialize the database with required tables.

This function creates the following tables if they do not exist: - students - instructors - courses - registrations

Parameters:

db_path (str, optional) – Path to the SQLite database file, defaults to DB_PATH
